entries.title: Spawning src/index.ts in jest without leaking servers
entries.summary: Use node_modules/.bin/ts-node directly with detached spawn and a process-group kill to test the server-start path of src/index.ts.

entries.title: Blank argv check in src/index.ts precedes --version and listen
entries.summary: src/index.ts rejects any empty or whitespace-only argv token via findBlankArgs before the --version check, exiting 1 with a single stderr line.

entries.title: SIGINT shutdown in src/index.ts uses close plus unref'd exit fallback
entries.summary: The server's SIGINT handler closes the http.Server and exits 130, with an unref'd 500ms timer as a fallback for stalled keep-alive connections; no SIGTERM handler, by design.
